scientific_integrity: Finite direct enumeration is corroborative, while exhaustive 48-state row identities and recurrence deductions support exact claims. Earlier general residue equidistribution and a modulus-eight versus modulus-six difference law are not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Exact only at dyadic endpoints and modulo eight; all-depth claims use finite integer matrix identities and spectral argument. Priority beyond inspected literature uncertain; no independent mathematical validation.
title: Complete modulo-eight residue spectra of Stern’s diatomic sequence on dyadic blocks
